title: Both directions — neither one is proof
text: Every field of a new investigation record doesn't prove it judged the situation correctly. A checklist can be followed to the letter and still miss what it was never asked to check. And watching it leave a field blank doesn't prove nothing's wrong. It may just be a case the checklist doesn't cover. A

title: Carry-out
text: Skill named investigation ad doesn't hand Claude authority to open or judge a case. It's a checklist Claude reads before it starts, so the same intake happens every time and anything outside those steps is still on you. Your turn.

title: Your turn
text: Paste this into Claude. Pick one record you fill out the same way every time, an incident log, an intake form, a status update. Write me a skill MD for it, plain language ordered steps.
